name: Sabrina
source:
"Distinguish whether what you seek is truly peace, or simply the satisfaction of your selfish desires."

Nationality: Maat
Role: President
Ability: Photographic memory

Sabrina, President of Maat, is one of the most respected leaders in the world—celebrated for her groundbreaking scientific achievements and unwavering dedication to progress. Under her guidance, Maat has become a beacon of innovation and reason.

Driven by a fierce commitment to knowledge and fairness, she champions inclusive governance, working to ensure that those without supernatural powers are never left behind.

Together with Ricky, she co-developed artifacts capable of harnessing supernatural powers through machinery—redefining the limits of what technology and science can achieve.

She's also one of the few people capable of holding a (relatively) normal conversation with Ricky.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yuri-eclipse/yuri-x-manga-x-visual-noveleclipse/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
